name: Bhaskar Agrochemicals Limited
about: Bhaskar Agrochemicals Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of formulation of agro chemicals in India. The company also engages in manufacturing and sales of crop care chemicals. Its products include fungicides, insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, plant growth promoters, and speciality plant nutrients. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
